attempts.detail: The implementation and 183 focused tests were available, but the dispatch run timed out before writing a compliant handoff; independent typecheck also identified one result-narrowing error.

corrections: Preserve old agent v3 read-only report compatibility while exact-validating every present v4 snapshot field.
Restore the original harness.json on every pre-commit failure and defer ACK instead of reporting failed after a confirmed commit.
Require signed pending defaults to match the repository's normalized origin identity before reporting them.
